crossRefs.note: Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be…
Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it…
For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will…
I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring…
“ ‘You sword of Yahweh, how long will it be before you are quiet? Put yourself back into your scabbard; rest, and be…
“How can you be quiet, since Yahweh has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there has he…
and say, ‘Yahweh, you have spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that no one will dwell in it, neither man nor…
to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.
We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all…
according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.
The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted…
The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be…
So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;
but Yahweh of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.
I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to…
Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…
But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”
He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

translations.web: Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
translations.bsb: The LORD of Hosts planned it, to defile all its glorious beauty, to disgrace all the renowned of the earth.
translations.kjv: The LORD of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
translations.asv: Jehovah of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
